notes: Each subgroup AAPC is tested only against zero; group differences in AAPCs are claimed side by side. Joinpoint family recorded as loglinear because APCs come from log-linear segments.
view_issues: Claims that AAPCs differ between groups (Hispanic vs non-Hispanic, West vs other regions) rest on no stated test. Table 1 female all-cancer AAPC −0.4 is marked significant though its CI (−0.7 to 0.2) includes zero.
